title: vektor /// no. 108 · The LAYER page: AirLLM's commands, memory table and Mac notes
description: AirLLM keeps one layer of a model on the GPU at a time, which is how its README runs Kimi K3 (2.8T) in 3.72 GB of GPU memory. The install commands including the Kimi K3 extras, the README memory table, the Mac notes, and the honest cost in speed and disk, each read at its source on 2026-11-27.
